note: All predictions are community-derived. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

predictions.title: Release Window
predictions.basis: Officially confirmed by Rockstar Games on March 27, 2026. Take-Two earnings call Feb 12, 2026 also cited Nov 19.
predictions.prediction_method: Official announcement cross-referenced with SEC EDGAR 8-K filing

predictions.title: Launch Price
predictions.basis: Pre-order listings across multiple retailers (Best Buy, Amazon) show $79.99. No official Rockstar pricing announcement yet.
predictions.prediction_method: Retailer pre-order price consensus + CPI-adjusted franchise pricing trend

predictions.title: Map Size
predictions.basis: Extrapolated from trailer landscape analysis and community mapping of confirmed regions. GTA V was 75km². 17 confirmed regions imply significant expansion.
predictions.prediction_method: Region count extrapolation × GTA V region density ratio + trailer frame analysis

predictions.title: Vehicles at Launch
predictions.basis: 268 vehicles already indexed from trailers and community. GTA V had 737 at launch. Franchise trend and confirmed vehicle diversity suggest comparable count.
predictions.prediction_method: Indexed vehicle count extrapolation × franchise launch-to-total ratio

predictions.title: GTA VI will feature regional price differentials
predictions.value: Vice City prices higher than Leonida
predictions.basis: Dual-territory Eurozone analogy — two structurally different regions sharing one currency (GTA$) historically produce purchasing power divergence. Urban density correlates with higher prices across GTA franchise history.

predictions.title: Shark Cards will have regional denomination tiers or access gates
predictions.value: Tiered Shark Card pricing per region
predictions.basis: Take-Two's recurring revenue dependency makes Shark Cards non-negotiable. Regional denominations or tiered access are the natural extension of the dual-territory model — mirroring real-world mobile game regional pricing strategies.

prediction_range.low: Single global SC rate with regional content gates

predictions.title: GTA VI will require a Regional Purchasing Parity index (GTA-RPP)
predictions.value: GTA-RPP ratio diverges between Vice City and Leonida
predictions.basis: If regional price differentials exist, a single GTA-PPI index will understate inflation for one region. The GTA-RPP — basket cost ÷ top hourly yield, computed per territory — is the essential post-launch metric for this site.

prediction_range.high: GTA-RPP diverges >30% — significant real wage gap between territories

predictions.title: Passive income businesses will be region-specific
predictions.value: Urban businesses in VC, agricultural/smuggling in Leonida
predictions.basis: Trailer evidence confirms clubs and heists in Vice City; farms and smuggling operations in Leonida. The dual-territory diagram explicitly labels these. Region-specific business types would produce natural wage and passive income divergence.

prediction_range.low: Cross-region businesses accessible but with efficiency penalties
prediction_range.high: Hard region locks — certain business types only viable in their native territory

predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis + Trailer Analysis

predictions.title: Lucia and Jason will have independent financial states
predictions.basis: GTA V established per-character financial independence (Michael, Trevor, Franklin each hold separate balances). Two protagonists in GTA VI naturally extends this — particularly relevant for a dual-territory model where each character may operate primarily in one region.

prediction_range.low: Shared wallet pool with per-character cosmetic preferences
prediction_range.high: Fully independent financial states, separate business portfolios per character

predictions.title: Maze Bank returns as decorative savings with no credit mechanic
predictions.value: Savings hold GTA$ but credit/loans remain absent
predictions.basis: Franchise-wide pattern: savings never compound in any GTA title. Maze Bank in GTA Online is explicitly decorative (no credit). No title has ever introduced a loan or credit mechanic — introducing one would fundamentally alter the Shark Card revenue model by reducing SC purchase urgency.

prediction_range.high: Savings with nominal interest, still no credit

predictions.title: GTA VI Online will have mobile-linked business persistence
predictions.value: Businesses run on mobile app between sessions
predictions.basis: Take-Two's live-service strategy and the dual-territory diagram explicitly lists mobile-linked persistence. Rockstar's iFruit app precedent (GTA Online) and the broader trend toward companion apps in AAA live-service games makes this a logical evolution.
prediction_inputs: GTA VI dual-territory projected sovereign levers

prediction_range.high: Active mobile management affecting in-game business state

predictions.title: GTA Online layer launches at or near Day 1
predictions.value: GTA Online VI launches within 30 days of story mode
predictions.basis: Take-Two's revenue model cannot sustain a 6-month GTA Online delay (as occurred with GTA V in 2013). Shark Card revenue is the primary live-service income stream. Each month of delay costs Take-Two significant recurring revenue at the highest-demand period in franchise history.
prediction_inputs: Take-Two revenue dependency on Shark Cards

predictions.title: GTA VI Megalodon Shark Card launch price
predictions.basis: GTA Online's Megalodon Shark Card has been $99.99 since 2013. CPI adjustment to 2026 (~35% inflation) implies a real-terms equivalent of ~$135, suggesting a nominal increase is economically justified. Take-Two has historically kept nominal prices flat while engineering real-terms inflation via payout nerfs. A price increase at the launch of a new title would be the cleanest reset point.
predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — franchise/cpi.json + shark-cards.json

predictions.title: GTA VI Online — top hourly yield at launch
predictions.basis: GTA Online launched at ~$250K/hr in 2013 and reached $2M/hr (Cayo Perico, 2020) before nerfs. The 8× yield growth over 7 years reflects both inflation and content scaling. GTA VI Online inherits the MMT sovereign model at a structurally higher yield floor. Historical nerf cadence suggests yields above $5M/hr are politically unsustainable for Rockstar's Shark Card model.

prediction_range.low: $2M/hr (continuation of current GTA Online S-tier floor)
prediction_range.high: $8M/hr (new heist format with full MMT rebalancing)

predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — meta-history.json + revenue-tiers.json

predictions.title: GTA VI endgame cost via Shark Cards at 12 months
predictions.basis: GTA Online's endgame cost via Shark Cards grew from ~$18.75 (2013) to ~$437.50 (2026) — a 23× increase over 13 years. GTA VI Online starts with a reset baseline but inherits the same structural incentive to expand the aspirational item stack. The $600–$900 range assumes a 30–100% premium over GTA Online's current endgame.
prediction_inputs: item-catalogue.json → price inflation rate per patch era

prediction_range.high: $1,200 (new high-tier aspirational vehicles + regional DLC stack)

predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — shark-cards.json endgame projection

predictions.title: First major payout nerf within 6 months of GTA VI Online launch
predictions.basis: GTA Online has delivered a major payout nerf within 6–18 months of every high-yield activity launch since 2015. Structural incentive: high yields suppress Shark Card sales. The question is not if GTA VI nerfs occur, but when.
prediction_inputs: shark-cards.json → Shark Card revenue correlation with yield

prediction_range.low: 3 months (if yield is high enough to threaten Shark Card revenue immediately)
prediction_range.high: 18 months (if Rockstar delays for goodwill at launch window)

predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — meta-history.json nerf cadence

predictions.title: GTA VI Online weekly event frequency matches GTA Online
predictions.basis: Weekly bonus events are the primary live-service engagement loop in GTA Online, operating continuously since 2017. Take-Two earnings reports consistently cite live events as a key monetisation driver. The weekly event cadence is a structural feature of the MMT sovereign model.

prediction_range.high: Weekly from Day 1 (continuation of GTA Online model)

predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — bonus-history.json cadence analysis
